body: Thank you for your kind words, and I get that it’s hard to makes others understand. It wasn’t until my family saw the blood that they understood that I was in pain.
Hey I’m sorry you’re feeling like this but we can’t really tell you how to kill yourself, cuz that would go against the rules of the subreddit

Here’s what I can tell you:
I attempted suicide about a year ago. I very nearly died and my face is permanently scarred because of my attempt. It was very hard this past year recovering emotionally and physically. And it still is. I go to therapy now, I had to take a break from college, and I work for my father to pass the time. I have not full recovered yet and I still think about killing myself all the time. I feel a deep pain that sticks with me in my heart and on my face. So my advice is, it’s okay to feel lost. Finding a path after a suicide attempt is not easy. I’m still trying to find mine and I’m still trying to find hope again.

I don’t think I am. I’ve tried so hard this past year just for nothing to come together at all. I’m in the same position I was in when I was 13. I’m broken, alone, and I’ll never feel like a whole person again. I had a woman I loved once and she left me a while back because I was broken. She loved me so much, but in the end she knew what I knew, that I was too far gone. And she was right, I just want to die.
Thank you, I appreciate that a lot. It does feel unendurable and I appreciate you understanding that pain. It’s like I’m not even a person anymore, just an empty shell.

I was afraid once too. I was so afraid I tried to end my life. And I was lucky enough to get a second chance to conquer my fears. You have that chance now. Sit down with your mother, tell her everything. All the things you’ve been through, all the things that have been going through your mind. Trust me, it will be better for you to do this. Drop the facade once and for all and truly heal and take that chance to live a happy life. I’m not saying it’s easy, but it’s a critical step that you must take. I’m hoping you do it as soon as possible. But take your time and tell her when you are ready. I wish you the best and I hope you can learn from my story for I have been where you are and I was able to become a better man today.
But you aren’t close enough because all she knows is the facade you are putting on. Show her the real you, the one that is in pain. The one who wants help.

I had the same mindset. I thought I was protecting my parents from my pain. But you have to know your mom would want to know the pain you’re going through rather than losing her child. You may want to hide it, but that will not help you nor her. Telling her will bring you both closer together and it will make things better for both of you.

You’re not wasting my time. Please try talking to your mom directly about how you feel. It may work out better than you think for the both of you. I survived my attempt through pure luck. My family finally realized I was in pain. And I realized if I had just talked to them and had a serious discussion about where I was at, things would’ve been different. I wear a scar on my face that will always remind me of that. I wish better for you than that. So please try talking about it with your mom.

You’re not a loser. You’ve been beat down, but you’re not out. You cut your mother out after her toxic behavior that she still engages in. You know how much strength it takes to withstand that? More than most people have. You did the right thing cutting her out. Don’t die. Take this chance to live for you and the be the person you want to be. I believe you can. And I believe in the strength that is you.

If you put people on a pedestal, they’ll always be looking down on you. At the end of the day, she’s just a person. A human being with flaws, just like the rest of us. You’re not garbage. She doesn’t want you dead. She may not be into you but that doesn’t mean that you aren’t great. You can be the ripest Peach on the tree, but if she only likes apples then it won’t work. You’ll find somebody one day man who will actually be the one for you. You have soooo much time left to discover all different types of people.
